{{Quote|Doogal Belstar is at the top of our current most wanted list, here on Naboo. He leads the Mauler Disciples. I want you to see if you can track him down for us.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Typho]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TMPW" />}}
'''Doogal Belstar''' was the leader of the [[Maulers]], and a wanted criminal who operated on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:TMPW" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> he was killed during a [[Royal Security Police Force]] [[Capture of Doogal Belstar|operation]] led by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Typho]].<ref name="SWG:TMPW" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:DoogalBelstar.jpg|250px|thumb|Randomly generated depictions of Doogal Belstar, including a female Aqualish depiction deemed non-canon in Legends]]
Doogal Belstar appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TMPW" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Doogal Belstar was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>

After each server reset, Doogal appeared under one of three potential spawn templates, including a Human male Mauler acolyte, a female [[Aqualish]] Mauler apprentice, or a Human male Mauler initiate. Since the quest dialogue identified Doogal as a male, this article assumes that one of the two Human depictions is [[canon]] in the [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] continuity.<ref name="SWG:TMPW" />
